talkingPoints.text: plump, glossy finish that helps give lips a volume-up look

benefits.text:
Unique ball-shaped design that spreads evenly with ease. Lightly glossy balm texture, non-sticky. Can be used on lips, cheeks and eyes. Moisturizes well, with no need for an extra lip balm.
Helps leave lips soft and smoothly moisturized, creating a plump, glossy effect and a filled-in look along lip lines. Clear, fresh colors that are easy to wear every day. Can be used as a balm blush.
• PEACH BALL: Includes peach-orange, coral pink and natural pink tones  
→ 01 Raw Rose Dew, 02 Honey Coral, 03 Bunny Pink, 04 Fever Dew  
• COCO BALL: Includes elegant red, beige and brown tones  
→ 05 Hug Dew, 06 Ginger Peach, 07 Carrot Jam, 08 Fig Rain  
• BERRY BALL: Includes deep plum-pink, cool and bold purple tones  
→ 09 Raw Grape Dew, 10 Cool Rose Dew, 11 Berry Coke, 12 Plummy  
• DEW BALL: Includes natural, lightly glossy shades that create a plump, juicy effect on lips  
→ 13 Soda Dew, 13 Soda Dew + 10 Cool Rose Dew

howToUse.text:
Apply directly to lips, 1 layer for a sheer color, multiple layers for a deeper and glossier effect.
Dab what's left onto cheeks for a light, glowy flush of color.
Can be used before makeup as a lip balm or layered on last as a lip gloss.

safety.text:
For external use on the lip area only; do not use on damaged lips,
Stop use if any unusual signs appear and keep out of reach of children.
